topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: When I first saw the image, my initial reaction was a moment of surprise, followed by a thoughtful consideration. It's not every day one finds their work immortalized on someone's skin. I took a deep breath, appreciating the depth of the gesture. It's a privilege, really, to have created something that resonates so profoundly with another person. After the initial shock, I felt a warmth, a kind of connection to this stranger who chose my art as a part of their story. I decided to reach out to them, not to demand explanations, but to share my gratitude and, perhaps, to learn more about what my art means to them.
